description.value:
You've trained to cast powers effectively at melee range.

Making a ranged force or tech attack while a hostile creature is within 5 feet of you no longer imposes disadvantage. Your ranged force and tech attacks ignore half and three-quarters cover against targets within 30 feet of you.

You learn one at-will power that requires an attack roll; your casting ability for it is Wisdom or Charisma (matching the power's alignment) for a force power, or Intelligence for a tech power.

system.requirements: 4th level, the ability to cast force or tech powers.
